headline: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela reached 701,000 b/d in July 2026, highest level since May 2017
facts: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day in July 2026 (EIA Petroleum Supply Monthly)
July 2026 import level is the highest since May 2017 (EIA official data)
U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela decreased to 655,000 barrels per day in August 2026 (EIA Petroleum Supply Monthly)
